name: Crimson Empire ~Circumstances to Serve a Noble~
original_name: クリムゾン・エンパイア ~Circumstances to Serve a Noble~
source:
The heroine is a head maid who has sworn absolute loyalty to Edvard, a prince, and would do anything to assist him to the throne. 

There are 2 princes who are fighting for the throne, Edvard and Justin. But because Justin's mother was of a lower rank, Edvard has more of a right to the throne. Therefore, Justin plots to assassin Edvard to get to the throne. The problem though, is that every time he sends an assassin, the heroine would defeat the assassins.

[Edited from [url=http://forum.my-neoromance.com/index.php?s=&showtopic=824&view=findpost&p=24451]My NeoRomance Forum[/url]]
translation:
女主角是一名女仆长，她向王子爱德华发誓绝对效忠，愿意不惜一切协助他登上王位。

爱德华与贾斯汀两位王子正在争夺王位。由于贾斯汀的母亲地位较低，爱德华拥有更优先的继承权。因此，贾斯汀为了夺取王位，密谋刺杀爱德华。然而问题在于，他每次派出的刺客都会被女主角击败。

[编辑自[url=http://forum.my-neoromance.com/index.php?s=&showtopic=824&view=findpost&p=24451]My NeoRomance Forum[/url]]
